entities.summary: Archbishop Emeritus Tan Sri Murphy Nicholas Xavier Pakiam was the third metropolitan archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, from 2003 to 2013. He is styled His Grace The Most Reverend Archbishop Tan Sri Datuk.
